searchText: You may need to make sure every scalar(32 bytes) in the blob data is less than the modulus. The Encode function may need to be modified If you guys see an ugly stack trace with `InMempoolForm` at the beginning of a line in nethermind logs - it's OK, we just log every place where infamous mempool form of the transactions is used. Totally fine to have it in `TransactionsMessageSerializer` Am I correct in understanding that the list of blob_versioned_hashes in the type 03 tx is unbounded in length? the spec offers no constraints on it. we are assuming the data_gas limits govern that, right? ```diff diff --git a/transactions.go b/transactions.go index 47e8a40..4649fa0 100644 --- a/transactions.go +++ b/transactions.go @@ -245,7 +245,7 @@ func encodeBlobs(data []byte) []kzg4844.Blob { if max > len(data) { max = len(data) } - copy(blobs[blobIndex][fieldIndex*32:], data[i:max]) + copy(blobs[blobIndex][fieldIndex*32+1:], data[i:max]) } return blobs } ``` Sorry about that <@199561711278227457> what tool have you been using to send blobs?
